channel.description:
Behind The Brew is a podcast for entrepreneurs and creators ready to make an impact. While it began in the hair and grooming world, it now explores the journeys of entrepreneurs and creators across all industries. Tune in for inspiring stories, practical insights, and real conversations with those shaping the future of business and creativity. 

Behind The Brew is hosted by Modern Man TV and Steve Lockhart
